verdict.rationale: Sill documents that it has no account and no server, and that your screen and typing travel only between your own devices. That structurally keeps your data away from the vendor, so it cannot be collected for AI training. However, the evidence never explicitly addresses AI training or gives a training opt-out policy. Missing for 10: an explicit statement that user data is never used to train AI models, independent verification of the no-server data flow.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models

citations.quote: There is no account and no server: your screen and what you type travel only between your own devices
only the devices you paired can connect, and every connection is encrypted
